governingIdea: Robb Francis on Forge's black stage: a thin serif voice and pinned chapters that end in one car rising through 'By Appointment Only', with the one thing Forge cannot have — a real California garage whose glass door rolls up to let you in.

taken.what: One load carried through the whole scroll and a tail that drops the level fails: Acts 7–8 are composed with the same care as the peak, and the closing is a designed ending, not the place the content went.
Video as a continuation of the environment, not a block: the hero film is a full-bleed field with the type standing in it, and the loop is trimmed so the subject is never cut by the frame.

rejected.why: Authored chaos that makes the visitor rediscover the interface: this audience arrives to book an appointment, so the navigation stays conventional and discoverable.
Transactional before aspirational — prices and incentives up front. A by-appointment collector house shows no prices and no urgency on the index.
